name: Ruby
description: Ruby is a tough, street-smart human girl from Eldraine in a red cloak, who travels with Kellan while searching for her missing brother.

bio.text: Ruby carried the collapsed Kellan to Hylda's ice castle and refused to abandon him, which convinced Hylda to relent, revive Kellan, give Ruby a sword and give up her crown.

status.text: After the fall of Castle Ardenvale, Will invited Ruby and Kellan to the palace, and the material gives no later story for her beyond card flavor text of her searching for her brother.

Ruby, Daring Tracker (Foundations, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Gonti threatens to have Saheeli's family executed, starting with her mother, and shows her mother's bracelet.
timeline.quote: If I don't send word in the allotted time, their instructions are to execute everyone.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Chapter 2: Antiquities
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 2: Antiquities" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Kellan asks around Edgewall for witches and is warned by Ruby not to touch a sleeper because of the Wicked Slumber.
timeline.quote: "The Wicked Slumber spreads, though no one's really sure how,"

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 2: Wandering Knight, Budding Hero
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 2: Wandering Knight, Budding Hero" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Ruby agrees to guide Kellan to Dunbarrow in exchange for help finding her brother Peter, after he vaguely names his fae liege.
timeline.quote: "All right. I guess someone's got to look out for you, and it might as well be me."

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 2: Wandering Knight, Budding Hero
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 2: Wandering Knight, Budding Hero" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: On the way they pass Phyrexian remnants and Ruby throws an apple at a laughing pixie.
timeline.quote: Ruby picks up an apple from her basket and flings it hard as a giant flinging a boulder

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 2: Wandering Knight, Budding Hero
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 2: Wandering Knight, Budding Hero" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: A wolf-armored archer attacks, and Kellan and Ruby flee.
timeline.quote: The Wolf Knight strides toward them.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 2: Wandering Knight, Budding Hero
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 2: Wandering Knight, Budding Hero" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Ruby leads Kellan through a pack of witchstalkers, who then chase off the Wolf Knight.
timeline.quote: The Wolf Knight runs into the woods as the witchstalkers give chase.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 2: Wandering Knight, Budding Hero
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 2: Wandering Knight, Budding Hero" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: They find a witch's thorny cabin and overhear her song about eating a knight.
timeline.quote: "When I was hungry a knight wandered in, wild at heart and covered in tin ..."

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 2: Wandering Knight, Budding Hero
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 2: Wandering Knight, Budding Hero" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: The Wolf Knight arrives, but when Ruby calls him Peter he removes his helm; it is her brother who was enchanted by the witch.
timeline.quote: "Peter!" Ruby shouts.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 2: Wandering Knight, Budding Hero
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 2: Wandering Knight, Budding Hero" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Peter helps carry the cauldron through a threshold to Talion's court, where Talion names Hylda as the next witch and the mirror Indrelon as the way to find her.
timeline.quote: "But consult the mirror Indrelon, and you may yet find her ."

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 2: Wandering Knight, Budding Hero
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 2: Wandering Knight, Budding Hero" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Ruby learns Kellan's liege is the fae king and decides to keep helping him.
timeline.quote: "You helped me find my brother, so I'll help.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 2: Wandering Knight, Budding Hero
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 2: Wandering Knight, Budding Hero" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Kellan and Ruby climb a beanstalk with the guide Troyan, who gives them frog potions for the leap to the clouds.
timeline.quote: "Pretty cool, huh? Don't worry, it's only temporary," Troyan says.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Kellan and Ruby leap to Stormkeld, the giants' castle, and slip inside while the giants waltz.
timeline.quote: "We're really here, huh?" she says. "Stormkeld."

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: The giant Beluna's goose chases them and Beluna seizes Kellan, accusing them of trying to steal the mirror at her birthday party.
timeline.quote: "What are you doing at my party?"

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Troyan tells the mirror something new, and it shows an ice castle at Loch Larent where Hylda lies.
timeline.quote: Beneath the condensation, he sees a castle of ice, faceted and glittering

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Kellan and Ruby return to Edgewall to find the Slumber's violet threads spreading across the town.
timeline.quote: Now, with a sinking heart, Kellan realizes that the victims are beyond counting.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Peter agrees to take them to Loch Larent, warning them to turn back if they cannot feel their noses, and Ruby promises.
timeline.quote: "You must wear my thickest cloak, and when you can no longer feel your nose, you must turn back.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Peter shows them a puppet show of a girl in a red hood defeating a witch, moving Ruby.
timeline.quote: All watch in perfect stillness as two puppets triumph over all manner of trouble to defeat an evil, man-eating witch.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Peter leaves them to camp as Kellan and Ruby approach Hylda's ice castle at Loch Larent.
timeline.quote: They bid farewell to Peter.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Hylda's voice warns them to turn back and summons frost warriors, one pinning Kellan's cloak and another seizing Ruby.
timeline.quote: Another warrior's formed, and this one's got her in its clutches.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Kellan pleads to his father and his hilts become a blade of light that cuts down the warriors' arms; he frees Ruby.
timeline.quote: his newfound sword cuts straight through the frost warrior's arm.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Kellan collapses from the cold and sleepiness, and Ruby catches him.
timeline.quote: Kellan falls.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Ruby carries Kellan toward the castle over Hylda's taunts, then crawls across the drawbridge past frozen bodies, refusing to abandon him.
timeline.quote: She shifts Kellan onto her back, throws her hands out ahead.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Hylda appears kneeling beside Ruby and Kellan, extends a hand, clears the weather, and puts them to sleep to keep them safe.
timeline.quote: "Be welcome in Winter's Home."

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: They wake in the ice castle where Hylda hands over her crown as proof of defeat, and the castle begins to melt.
timeline.quote: "Take that to the Kindly Lord, as proof of my defeat."

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Hylda reveals the witches did not create the Slumber alone and that Talion proposed Eriette's sleeping curse for a boon.
timeline.quote: Talion was the one who broke the stalemate.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Kellan storms out and goes through Talion's portal with Ruby to confront him, throwing the crown at his feet.
timeline.quote: Kellan throws the crown at Talion's feet.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Talion defends himself, says fae do not lie, and tells Kellan to defeat Eriette at Castle Ardenvale to learn of his father.
timeline.quote: "You shall find Eriette at Castle Ardenvale.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Back outside Hylda's castle Kellan weeps.
timeline.quote: Kellan begins to weep.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Kellan and Ruby ride to Castle Ardenvale on ponies and use the second frog potion to jump over its gates.
timeline.quote: They're in the air seconds later.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Inside they find Rowan in the throne room studying curse notes; Kellan reads her note about attempting to put people to sleep before she knocks him out with sparks.
timeline.quote: Kellan's vision goes white.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Kellan wakes in a cell, freed by Ruby, who says Rowan knocked them out and was trying to work dream magic on him when Will's army arrived.
timeline.quote: "Syr Rowan knocked us both out.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Kellan and Ruby attack Eriette's throne while Rowan reveals Eriette is their aunt and begs Will to save her; Will says he doesn't know her anymore.
timeline.quote: "I don't know you anymore," he says.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Ruby holds her blade to Eriette's throat; Eriette tells Rowan by thread to leave and bide their time.
timeline.quote: Go from this place, Eriette says to her. When the time is right, we will meet again.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Will thanks Kellan and Ruby and invites them to the palace; Kellan slips away to the Fae World.
timeline.quote: Outside of Castle Ardenvale he steps into the Fae World.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Retellings of Agatha's demise make Kellan taller and Ruby stronger, while the core story stays the same.
timeline.quote: With every retelling of Agatha's demise, Kellan got taller and Ruby got stronger.

citation.work: A Tale for the Ages
citation.text: A Tale for the Ages (Wilds of Eldraine Promos, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Hylda watches Ruby drag Kellan's unconscious body through the cold and feels compassion for the first time in a long while.
timeline.quote: As Hylda watched Ruby drag Kellan's unconscious form through the cold, Hylda felt something she hadn't felt in a long time: compassion.

citation.work: Break the Spell
citation.text: Break the Spell (Wilds of Eldraine, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kellan and Ruby flee witchstalkers drawn to dark magic around an armored figure.
timeline.quote: Kellan and Ruby fled to the sound of savage howls and snapping jaws.

citation.work: Witchstalker Frenzy
citation.text: Witchstalker Frenzy (Wilds of Eldraine, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kellan, with Ruby, kills Agatha and defeats Hylda.
timeline.quote: Kellan, with the help of Ruby , succeeded in killing Agatha and defeating Hylda.

citation.text: "Kellan", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "Kellan", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashiok and Eriette tell Rowan of her lost spark and family tie; she joins her aunt, and fights Will, who defeats Ashiok and captures Eriette while Rowan escapes.
timeline.quote: Will was able to defeat Ashiok with the help of Kellan and Ruby

citation.work: Rowan Kenrith
citation.text: "Rowan Kenrith", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.quote: capture the witch Eriette , ending the Wicked Slumber.

citation.text: "Will Kenrith", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: Ruby, Daring Tracker (Foundations, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ruby's selflessness convinces Hylda to relent and relinquish her crown, and Hylda kisses Kellan's forehead and protects them from the cold.
